Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
com.articulate.sigma.user.UserManager
public final class UserManager extends Object
A class that encrypts a string and checks it against another stored encrypted string, in order to validate a user login.

    • createUser

      public boolean createUser(javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, String username, String password, String email, String role, String firstName, String lastName, String organization, String notRobot)
      Creates a new user account after confirming admin access.
      Parameters:
      request - the current HTTP request
      username - the new user's username
      password - the new user's password
      email - the new user's email
      role - the user's role: user, admin, or guest
      firstName - the user's first name
      lastName - the user's last name
      organization - the user's organization
      notRobot - the user's verification statement
      Returns:
      true if the user was created successfully
